board_summary.disposition_reason: Board REJECTED: Contains 4 critical P1 defect(s) violating IPC-A-600 Class 2/3 criteria. Severe functional circuit failure or hazardous electrical bridge detected.

board_level_intelligence.acceptance_rationale: Quarantined: Board marked REJECT due to critical conductor anomalies violating IPC-A-600 Class 3. Do not power on.
major_risks: Short Circuit: Unwanted copper bridge risks frying downstream components.
Open Circuit: Broken signal trace causes complete circuit failure.
Mouse Bite: Narrowed conductor neck can overheat under operating current.
Spur: Copper protrusion encroaches on safe dielectric clearance.
immediate_priorities: Defect #3 (Short · P1_CRITICAL): Cut copper bridge to isolate short
Defect #4 (Open · P1_CRITICAL): Solder jumper wire across broken trace
Defect #2 (Mousebite · P1_CRITICAL): Check trace width and patch if >20% loss

process_intelligence.pattern_summary: Mixed defect distribution (6 anomalies): Both conductor necking (over-etch) and excess copper (under-etch) observed.
fab_stage_hypotheses: Etch Tank Over-Etching (1 open, 1 mousebite): Acid bath concentration or conveyor dwell time too high.
Photolithography / Under-Etching (1 short, 1 spur): Clogged developer spray nozzles or unremoved resist residue.
Plating Aeration (1 pin-holes): Air micro-bubbles trapped on copper during electroplating.
Stripping Tank Residue (1 copper flakes): Incomplete photoresist stripping or copper flake redeposition.
recommended_investigations: Audit CuCl₂ acid concentration and calibrate line conveyor speed.
Inspect developer spray nozzles and verify UV exposure energy.
Inspect air spargers in plating tank and check cleanroom air filters.
Clean stripping chamber filters and refresh cascade rinse bath.
process_intelligence.disclaimer: Diagnostic hypotheses for line engineering. Confirm with bath titration and SPC logs.
